content.title: Delta Reports Earnings Tuesday. Why It Can Boost Airline Stocks.
content.summary: Delta  Air Lines reports fourth-quarter earnings on Tuesday, which could set the flight path for the sector’s stocks for the remainder of 2026.  The industry had a turbulent year in 2025 but ultimately proved resilient, bouncing back from a number of headwinds, including hits to demand and sentiment from President Donald Trump’s trade policy and the 43-day government shutdown.  Delta, the first carrier to report this earnings season, will set the tone for the industry this year—and things may be looking up.

content.title: Allegiant to Buy Sun Country in Deal Valued at $1.5 Billion
content.summary: Sun Country’s shareholders will receive 0.1557 shares of Allegiant common stock and $4.10 in cash per Sun Country share, the companies said Sunday.  The offer is about 20% above Sun Country’s closing share price Friday, according to a release.  Shares in Sun Country rose as much as 18% to $18.54 in premarket trading Monday, while Allegiant was little changed.
